# Manifest

*Generated by `make manifest`. Verify a checkout with `uv run verify-manifest`.*

- schema version **4**
- built from commit `53d87dd7529c` — necessarily the parent of the commit holding this file
- 1,051,560 pooled seat-event records, 1,202,319 candidates, 13,473 supplemental rows, and 238,091 local parsed rows
- written by **pyarrow 23.0.1** — parquet records its writer in every footer, so a different version changes every hash below without changing a value

## Schema

`master_columns` records the exact ordered column list, so a consumer can detect a schema change without diffing a header:

```
dataset_id, row_id, seat_key, seat_key_unique, state, year, election_type, election_duration, district, block, body, gp_no, gram_panchayat, gp_term, ward_no, ward_name, seat_no, district_latin, block_latin, gram_panchayat_latin, tier, tier_local, caste_reservation, caste_reservation_local, caste_scheme, woman_reserved, reservation, reservation_raw, listing_scope, unit_of_observation, seat_candidates, winner, winner_latin, winner_basis, votes, runner_up, runner_up_votes, margin, vacant, unopposed, script, source_repo, source_commit, source_path, source_page, provenance_level, quality_flags
```

`candidate_columns` does the same for the long candidate tables:

```
dataset_id, candidate_id, row_id, seat_key, candidate_no, state, year, election_type, election_duration, district, block, body, gp_no, gram_panchayat, ward_no, seat_no, tier, tier_local, caste_reservation, woman_reserved, candidate_name, relation_name, candidate_gender, candidate_woman, candidate_age, candidate_caste, candidate_education, candidate_marital_status, candidate_occupation, candidate_total_assets, candidate_children_before_1995_11_27, candidate_children_after_1995_11_27, party, votes, candidate_rank, elected, result, source_repo, source_commit, source_path, source_page
```
